name: Hadoti Palace Restaurant
why_it_matters: Heritage hotel originally built as a residence for the Royal Family of Badnore — 43 rooms today, with a family-friendly restaurant that does both buffet and a la carte. The terrace view of Taragarh Fort is the property's distinguishing feature.
insider_tip: The terrace and pool deck open around 6 pm — order an early dinner up there rather than the indoor hall, which gets warm in summer evenings.
signature_address: The Hadoti Palace, Civil Lines, Bundi, Rajasthan 323001

name: Bundi Vilas Rooftop
signature_dish: rooftop set dinner with Garh Palace view
why_it_matters: Boutique 7-room haveli converted in 2008, built directly into the rampart walls of Bundi's Garh Palace — accessed on foot through a 40-foot stone archway. The rooftop terrace serves dinner, framed by the lit-up palace and the deep-blue old town below.
insider_tip: Dinner is a single sitting, set menu, residents-priority. Call by lunchtime if you're a non-resident; the kitchen plans plate counts for the rooftop only.
signature_address: Bundi Vilas, Balchand Para, Old City, Bundi, Rajasthan 323001

name: Kasera Heritage View Rooftop Restaurant
why_it_matters: Revamped haveli 500 m from Taragarh Fort and Bundi Palace — the rooftop sits at exactly the right elevation to see both the palace and the Jait Sagar lake side of town. Lonely Planet listing; ranked #5 of 13 hotels in Bundi.
insider_tip: Breakfast is the move here, not dinner — the morning light hits the palace ramparts directly opposite the rooftop and that is the shot that makes Kasera local-famous.
signature_address: Kasera Heritage View, Balchand Para, near Garh Palace, Bundi, Rajasthan 323001
